# chess-openings (vendored)

`a.tsv` … `e.tsv` from <https://github.com/lichess-org/chess-openings>,
fetched 2026-08-06 from the master branch. Licensed CC0 1.0 (public domain
dedication) by the lichess.org team.

Vendored so `npm run build:openings` works offline and reproducibly. To
refresh, re-download the five TSVs and rerun the script.
